verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch14.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, regional comparisons, start years of each series)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0)
verification.result: All 3,745 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; Tunisia's 'above 15% since 2011' was corrected to 'since 2015' (2014 was 14.3%) and the Dominican Republic's 'among the stronger records' was replaced by its checked rank (third in the region after Guyana and Panama) before publishing; Jordan's remittances end in 2024, stated on the page
